name: Phoebe Mu
title: Founder
bio: Phoebe provides high-quality, one-on-one piano and theory tuition, guiding students from their very first lesson through to AMEB diploma level.
qualifications: LTCL & LMusA — Licentiate diplomas in Piano Performance (Trinity College London & AMEB)

name: Harmoniche Deng
bio: Harmoniche teaches one-on-one piano. Originally from Perth, he studied with Luciano Trebse and is now studying medicine at the Australian National University.

name: Angel Zheng
bio: Angel teaches one-on-one flute, piano and voice. A pianist, flautist and chorister, she is studying Political Science and Music, majoring in Piano Performance, at the Australian National University.
